<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
  <title>Vibe2 bootstrap</title>
  <style>
    body {
      font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      background-color: #f0f0f0;
    }
    main {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      height: 100vh;
      padding: 20px;
      background-color: #fff;
    }
    #game {
      width: 600px;
      height: 400px;
      background-color: #e0e0e0;
      border: 2px solid #ccc;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 60px);
      grid-template-rows: repeat(8, 60px);
      gap: 5px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .square {
      width: 60px;
      height: 60px;
      background-color: #ddd;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 24px;
      color: #333;
      border: 1px solid #aaa;
    }
    .selected {
      background-color: #00ff00;
    }
    .piece {
      width: 60px;
      height: 60px;
      background-color: #fff;
      border: 2px solid #000;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 24px;
      color: #000;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <main id="game"></main>
  <script>
    const game = document.getElementById('game');
    const squares = [];
    const pieces = [];

    function createSquare(x, y) {
      const square = document.createElement('div');
      square.classList.add('square');
      square.dataset.x = x;
      square.dataset.y = y;
      square.addEventListener('click', () => selectSquare(x, y));
      game.appendChild(square);
      squares.push(square);
    }

    function createPiece(x, y, piece) {
      const pieceDiv = document.createElement('div');
      pieceDiv.classList.add('piece');
      pieceDiv.textContent = piece;
      game.appendChild(pieceDiv);
      pieces.push(pieceDiv);
    }

    function selectSquare(x, y) {
      const square = squares.find(s => s.dataset.x === x && s.dataset.y === y);
      if (square) {
        square.classList.add('selected');
        const piece = pieces.find(p => p.dataset.x === x && p.dataset.y === y);
        if (piece) {
          piece.classList.add('selected');
        }
      }
    }

    // Initialize game
    for (let x = 0; x < 8; x++) {
      for (let y = 0; y < 8; y++) {
        createSquare(x, y);
        if (x === 0 && y === 0) {
          createPiece(x, y, 'R');
        } else if (x === 7 && y === 7) {
          createPiece(x, y, 'r');
        }
      }
    }

    // Simple AI for opponent
    function aiMove() {
      const emptySquares = [];
      for (let x = 0; x < 8; x++) {
        for (let y = 0; y < 8; y++) {
          if (!squares.find(s => s.dataset.x === x && s.dataset.y === y) && !pieces.find(p => p.dataset.x === x && p.dataset.y === y)) {
            emptySquares.push({ x, y });
          }
        }
      }
      if (emptySquares.length > 0) {
        const randomSquare = emptySquares[Math.floor(Math.random() * emptySquares.length)];
        const piece = pieces.find(p => p.dataset.x === randomSquare.x && p.dataset.y === randomSquare.y);
        if (piece) {
          piece.classList.remove('selected');
        }
        createPiece(randomSquare.x, randomSquare.y, 'O');
      }
    }

    // Game loop
    function gameLoop() {
      aiMove();
      requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
    }

    gameLoop();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
